title: Hanasato Minori — Beyond The Spotlight〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Humhumhuum♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Thank goodness our solo show went so well!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You shined so much as you sang and danced. Actually, this may've been your brightest moment thus far.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I agree. As a fellow idol, I'm kinda jealous, but you were definitely the center of everyone's attention during today's show...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You reminded me of why I fell in love with idols in the first place...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And the way you performed on stage today showed me that I'll have to do everything I can to keep up with you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(The way they all said that...
It made me so happy.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
I did it again! I'm giggling after reminiscing about what happened...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's okay as long as I'm in my room, but I really need to avoid doing that while walking to school...

rows.Speaker: Junior High Schooler A
rows.Line: E-Excuse me...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Eep! I'm sorry!

rows.Speaker: Junior High Schooler A
rows.Line: Wah! I-I'm sorry too! I didn't mean to surprise you!

rows.Speaker: Junior High Schooler B
rows.Line: But... You're Minori, right? From MORE MORE JUMP!?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Y-Yes, that's me.

rows.Speaker: Junior High Schooler A
rows.Line:
Wow, I knew it...!
We're huge MMJ fans! Us and another friend of ours always watch your streams together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really?! I'm so happy to hear that!
Thank you all very much!

rows.Speaker: Junior High Schooler B
rows.Line:
No, you don't need to thank us...!
If anything, we need to thank you for giving us so much encouragement!

rows.Speaker: Junior High Schooler B
rows.Line: I didn't have enough saved up to go to your solo show... But my other friends told me all about it...!

rows.Speaker: Junior High Schooler A
rows.Line: They called me right after they left the venue, and were crying like babies saying how moved they were by your performance!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really?!
We were actually all pretty nervous since it was our very first solo show...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I'm really glad to hear that they enjoyed it!

rows.Speaker: Junior High Schooler A
rows.Line: They did! And I've decided that I'm gonna go see your next show no matter what!

rows.Speaker: Junior High Schooler B
rows.Line: I really hope you do another show sometime! I promise to save up as much as possible so that I can purchase a ticket along with merch!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, I'm sure we will have another show sometime! I hope to see you there!

rows.Speaker: Junior High Schooler A
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
C-Can we shake hands?!
Is that allowed?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Of course.
That is, if it's okay with you...

rows.Speaker: Junior High Schooler A
rows.Line:
Oh wow...
I can't believe this is happening...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Hehe. I'm shaking hands with a fan... Like a real idol!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (No, I am a real idol!!)

rows.Speaker: Junior High Schooler B
rows.Line: Um, can we also shake hands...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yes! I mean... Of course!

rows.Speaker: Junior High Schooler A
rows.Line:
Wow...!
I'm really shaking hands with Minori...!

rows.Speaker: Junior High Schooler B
rows.Line:
Thank you so much!
I still can't believe this!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, it was my pleasure!
Let's meet again during our next show or event!

rows.Speaker: Junior High Schooler A & B
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mind if we also shook hands?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yes, of course!
H-Haruka...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're here too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
A-Airi?! Shizuku?!
What are you all doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What do you mean...?
This is how we get to school.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We have our morning practice to look forward to as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, those fans of yours seemed so happy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They really did. You did a good job of interacting with them as an idol.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! Way to go, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?! Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our solo show was a success, and you are what all of our fans seem to be talking about.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Based on what we saw just now, you seem to be able to handle them just fine, but this is gonna start happening more often when you're out in public. Are you prepared for that?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Anyway, let's head to our morning practice♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hm? I got a message. From who...?

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: <Congratulations on a successful solo show! You could've told me, you know? I totally would've gone!>

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: <Not only did you make your dream come true, but it's like you're blazing ahead towards bigger and better things.>

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: <But I'm not letting you hog all the glory.>

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: <I'm also gonna make my dream come true by becoming a dancer, so let's both keep doing our best, Minori!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Chi...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (We go to different schools now and haven't seen each other in so long. But it's great to hear that Chi's still trying to make her dream come true...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Yeah. Let's both do our best, Chi!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori? Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're gonna leave you behind if you don't hurry.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, yeah... Be right there!
